regimeSub: 10Y eases 6bp to 5.22% on 30Y demand but bear steepener intact; SPX +0.6% as VIX compresses to 14.84.
themes: 10Y yield -6bp to 5.22% from 5.28% after Thu 30Y auction 'found solid demand' per Reuters → 2s10s narrows to +47bp but steepener remains as term premium repricing continues with yields still at 24-year highs

Fed Chair Warsh boxed in: NYT Oct 8 reports 'Top Fed Official Casts Further Doubt on Rate Rise This Month' yet Aug CPI stuck at 3.7% YoY and core PCE at 3.0% → Sep NFP miss of 29K per CNBC keeps stagflation narrative alive
SPX +0.6% to 7811 reclaims weekly highs as bond selloff pauses → KOSPI -3.1% to 6420 underperforms on BOK 3.0% rate pressure; SK Hynix ADR divergence signals Korea-specific HBM valuation concerns
Brent +0.4% to $103.27 despite Jun US-Iran interim deal as Saudi disruptions linger → gold +0.4% to $4224 fresh ATH as stagflation hedge bid accelerates; VIX -3.7% to 14.84 on rates relief
